headline: Valkyries say Nakase OK after collapsing late in Game 3 win
description: The Valkyries said coach Natalie Nakase was feeling lightheaded and exhausted when she collapsed on the court late in their Game 3 win but said she was fine after the game and is expected to coach Sunday's Game 1 of the semifinals.

headline: Williams leads charge from 16 down, puts Valkyries in WNBA semis
